STORIES.headline: Ofgem sets January cap at £2,166 for a typical household
STORIES.summary: Ofgem’s January price cap takes the annual cost of typical household gas and electricity use in Great Britain from £1,723 to £2,166.
article: Ofgem’s January price cap takes the annual cost of typical household gas and electricity use in Great Britain from £1,723 to £2,166. The £443 difference is an illustration based on typical consumption. What a household actually pays depends on how much energy it uses, as well as the standing charges.

The new rates take effect on 1 January in England, Scotland and Wales. It is the third quarterly rise in succession. The Guardian linked the latest increase to higher wholesale gas prices. Separately, the government has announced a £100 payment towards energy costs for around 20 million households in January.
STORIES.imageAlt: Ofgem sets January cap at £2,166 for a typical household

STORIES.headline: Pakistani astronaut reaches Tiangong aboard Shenzhou-24
STORIES.summary: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali reached China’s Tiangong space station on Wednesday, becoming the first Pakistani astronaut to visit it.
article: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali reached China’s Tiangong space station on Wednesday, becoming the first Pakistani astronaut to visit it. Dawn reported that the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft docked three hours and 38 minutes after launch. People gathered at Pakistan’s space agency headquarters in Islamabad to follow the flight.

Ali is the payload specialist on a three-person crew. Commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi joined him for the launch from Jiuquan aboard a Long March rocket. The Times of India reported that Ali is expected to carry out scientific experiments during a short stay on the station.
STORIES.imageAlt: A split image of a spaceship blasting off and an astronaut smiling in a space suit.

STORIES.headline: Fossil fuel dispute leaves COP31 without an overarching agreement
STORIES.summary: Negotiations at the COP31 summit in Antalya ran two days beyond their planned finish and ended without agreement on an overarching statement.
article: Negotiations at the COP31 summit in Antalya ran two days beyond their planned finish and ended without agreement on an overarching statement. The draft put forward by the Turkish and Australian conveners omitted fossil fuels. The European Union and other participants withheld the consensus needed to adopt it.

The outcome leaves a specific gap. Countries have used closing statements to set a political direction, but the formal Paris Agreement process can continue without one. Its procedures still include national emissions pledges on a five-year cycle. Analyses in Scroll.in and The Conversation identified the treatment of oil, gas and coal as the division the talks failed to resolve.
STORIES.imageAlt: Fossil fuel dispute leaves COP31 without an overarching agreement

STORIES.headline: Microsoft orders engineering review after November cloud outage
STORIES.summary: Microsoft has put work on preventing and recovering from major outages at the top of its engineering agenda, according to internal memos reviewed by Reuters.
article: Microsoft has put work on preventing and recovering from major outages at the top of its engineering agenda, according to internal memos reviewed by Reuters. A disruption spanning 12 and 13 November left customers without Exchange Online email and also affected Outlook, Teams and other Microsoft 365 services.

Microsoft traced the failure to a Windows scaling defect introduced in July. The response exposed another problem. Engineers exchanged thousands of messages across separate chats while diagnostic information sat in different tracking systems. The internal review calls for work on recovering services more quickly and containing problems within geographic regions.

STORIES.headline: Meta brings its Muse assistant to the UK
STORIES.summary: Meta has launched Muse in the UK after introducing the assistant in the United States in September.
article: Meta has launched Muse in the UK after introducing the assistant in the United States in September. Users can give it tasks such as finding a journey or shopping for a present, either through its own app or on WhatsApp. Meta names retailers including Currys and Marks & Spencer among its UK partners.

The service can use payment credentials through Stripe’s Link wallet. Meta says users choose which accounts Muse can access and approve important actions before it proceeds. The Guardian reported that UK regulators are following the launch over privacy and consumer protection.
STORIES.imageAlt: A man walks past an advert for Meta Muse on the New York Subway

STORIES.headline: Shein agrees to $100 million settlement over US shopping claims
STORIES.summary: Shein has agreed to pay $100 million to settle US Federal Trade Commission allegations about delivery promises, customer reviews and the origin of cotton in some products.
article: Shein has agreed to pay $100 million to settle US Federal Trade Commission allegations about delivery promises, customer reviews and the origin of cotton in some products. The commission filed its complaint in California. The money is intended to reimburse customers, according to the South China Morning Post.

The commission said some cotton presented to shoppers as US-grown came from China, and that the origin of cotton in other items could not be traced. The settlement also addresses what customers see before buying. Shein agreed to give accurate shipping information and to stop blocking negative reviews.
STORIES.imageAlt: Shein agrees to $100 million settlement over US shopping claims

STORIES.headline: Amazon plans UK car reservations with purchases completed at dealerships
STORIES.summary: Amazon plans to bring its vehicle marketplace to Britain in early 2027, its first expansion for the service outside the United States.
article: Amazon plans to bring its vehicle marketplace to Britain in early 2027, its first expansion for the service outside the United States. Hyundai is the first manufacturer named for the launch. Used cars from the dealership group Vertu Motors are also due to appear on the site.

Shoppers will be able to compare specifications and prices, explore financing and get an estimate for a trade-in. A customer can then reserve a car through Amazon and visit the dealer to finish the purchase and collect it. Dealers will set the selling prices themselves.
STORIES.imageAlt: Amazon Autos Plans to Launch Services in U.K. in Early 2027

STORIES.headline: EasyJet brings forward aircraft retirements as fuel costs bite
STORIES.summary: EasyJet plans to retire more than 50 Airbus A319 aircraft over the next two years and replace them with larger, more fuel-efficient planes.
article: EasyJet plans to retire more than 50 Airbus A319 aircraft over the next two years and replace them with larger, more fuel-efficient planes. The carrier reported £71 million in pre-tax profit for the year to the end of September, a fall of almost 90 per cent.

Chief executive Kenton Jarvis said the conflict in the Middle East had affected both demand and fuel prices. Alongside the fleet changes, the airline said it had secured prices below the current jet fuel spot price for almost 70 per cent of its fuel contracts. The results come after shareholders approved a proposed takeover by Apollo.
STORIES.imageAlt: EasyJet brings forward aircraft retirements as fuel costs bite
